hints.title: Counting Small Fractions
hints.text: Count how many fractions are less than or equal to a target value by traversing numerators and denominators.

hints.title: Monotonic Two Pointer Count
hints.text: For a fixed mid value in range 0 to 1, as the denominator index increases, the matching numerator index also moves monotonically forward.

hints.title: Range Bisection and Best Candidate
hints.text: Bisect the continuous fraction range. In each check, count fractions <= mid and record the largest fraction encountered. Adjust search boundaries until count matches k.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of prime array arr
complexity.notes: Binary search over real interval [0, 1] with two-pointer counting in O(N) per probe.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating and sorting all O(N^2) fractions exceeds time and memory limits for large N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) compared to O(N^2) for sorting all pairs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use two pointers to count fractions <= mid in linear time while tracking max fraction <= mid.
